params.name: updated_after
params.description: Only return organizations updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z). Timezone offsets are honored; a value with no offset is treated as UTC. The comparison is strictly after. If omitted, all organizations in the group are returned.
